main.description: Returns one indexed funding receipt and hydrates its publisher actor. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: Funding-receipt AT-URI using a DID authority; lookup matches the URI only, not a CID.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or is not a funding-receipt record AT-URI.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed funding receipt exists at this AT-URI.

errors.name: ReceiptQueryFailed
errors.description: The receipt query or publisher hydration failed.

receiptView.description: Funding receipt with its publisher actor hydrated; the indexed record is unchanged, including its decimal-string amount, and party and funded-target references are not expanded. Missing publisher profile or organization sidecars are null; indexedAt is null when the index has no timestamp. A receipt is not proof of payment.
